arguments.content:
import pandas as pd

path = "budget.xlsx"
xls = pd.ExcelFile(path)
print("Sheets:", xls.sheet_names)

for sheet in xls.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=sheet, header=None)
    print(f"\n--- Sheet: {sheet} ({df.shape[0]} rows x {df.shape[1]} cols) ---")
    print(df.to_string())

import zipfile

z = zipfile.ZipFile("budget.xlsx")
raw = z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode('utf-8')
print(raw)

import zipfile
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

NS = {'x': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}
z = zipfile.ZipFile("budget.xlsx")
root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))
data = root.find('x:sheetData', NS)

cells = {}
for row in data.findall('x:row', NS):
    for c in row.findall('x:c', NS):
        ref = c.get('r')
        t = c.get('t')
        v = c.find('x:v', NS)
        if v is not None and v.text is not None:
            val = v.text
            if t == 'n':
                val = float(val)
                val = int(val) if val.is_integer() else val
            cells[ref] = val
        else:
            is_el = c.find('x:is', NS)
            if is_el is not None and t == 'inlineStr':
                text = ''.join(tt.text or '' for tt in is_el.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t'))
                cells[ref] = text

cats = ['Housing', 'Transportation', 'Food', 'Entertainment', 'Savings']
subtotals = {c: 0 for c in cats}
order = []
for r in range(11, 23):
    cat = cells.get(f'A{r}')
    item = cells.get(f'B{r}')
    amt = cells.get(f'C{r}')
    order.append((cat, item, amt))
    subtotals[cat] += amt

total = sum(subtotals.values())
print("Expense line items:")
for cat, item, amt in order:
    print(f"  {cat:<15} {item:<16} {amt}")
print("\nCategory subtotals:")
for cat in cats:
    print(f"  {cat:<15} {subtotals[cat]}")
print(f"\nTOTAL EXPENSES: {total}")
print(f"\nSheet formula C23: SUM(C11:C22) -> {total}")
